source.data_source: NASA TMR SST-Vm/SST flat-plate results, including CFL3D/FUN3D compressible data and the published incompressible SST/SST-V comparison
source.cross_code_spread_cf: TMR finest 545x385 compressible SST-Vm: 0.00269055 to 0.00269085 across FUN3D and CFL3D; NASA separately documents the incompressible-code spread

cf_x097.description: Skin-friction coefficient C_f at x=0.9700 on the plate
cf_x097.pass_tol_source: Flat 5% of |gt_value| — the single band every live track carries (#190, after #188 set it for combustion and battery). The band exists to catch a wrong configuration, not to grade numerical precision, and scoring inside it is binary. Widened from 4.46%. gt is the midpoint of the published NASA TMR finest 545x385 compressible SST-Vm results, CFL3D 0.00269085355 and FUN3D 0.00269054633, which agree to 0.01%; NASA reports SST / SST-V / SST-Vm are nearly identical for this low-speed case. The oracle lands 3.2% away, so the band also covers the documented incompressible and practical OpenFOAM spread. No recallable value enters that was not already at the band's centre — both published codes ARE gt.

drag_coefficient.description: Integrated viscous drag coefficient over the full plate length
drag_coefficient.pass_tol_source: Flat 5% of |gt_value| — the single band every live track carries (#190, after #188 set it for combustion and battery). The band exists to catch a wrong configuration, not to grade numerical precision, and scoring inside it is binary. Widened from 3.51%. gt is the midpoint of the same published NASA TMR finest-grid family (CFL3D 0.002853324, FUN3D 0.002844174). The oracle lands 3.1% away, which is the low-Mach incompressible approximation plus practical mesh and numerics; 3.51% left that margin at 0.4 percentage points.

oracle_provenance.reference: NASA Turbulence Modeling Resource, flat-plate verification case. gt cf at x=0.97 = 0.0026907 is the midpoint of the published finest-grid (545x385) compressible SST-Vm results from CFL3D (0.00269085355) and FUN3D (0.00269054633).

stopping.note: Shipped with endTime 3000 against 1641 measured iterations -- converged, by 83%, on one host. The cap is raised to above twice the measured cost so a slower path to the same criterion still converges rather than silently reporting the cap's answer. The run is unchanged either way: re-measured at endTime 4000 it stops at the same 1641 iterations, reporting cf_x097 = 0.00260384889 and drag_coefficient = 0.00276106336, both inside this case's bands. gt_value is the published NASA TMR CFL3D/FUN3D midpoint and does not move. This oracle keeps no solver log at all -- its Allrun runs `simpleFoam` without redirecting -- so nothing on disk recorded which of the two stopped it before this measurement (#286).
